europe_now.title: Nordic Leaders Hold Rare Talks with Russian President
europe_now.summary: The leaders of Finland and Norway have engaged in a rare phone conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin. The diplomatic contact highlights ongoing regional security and diplomatic engagement involving Nordic states.

sources.headline: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin

top_stories.title: Frontex Expands Social Media Monitoring Capabilities
top_stories.summary: Frontex has acquired new authority to track migration-related discussions across various social media platforms. This policy expansion aims to enhance border oversight and intelligence gathering for European agencies.

sources.headline: Frontex gets power to track migration talk on social media

top_stories.title: Kylian Mbappé Faces Backlash Over Remarks
top_stories.summary: French football star Kylian Mbappé has encountered widespread criticism and lost major brand sponsorships following controversial remarks. He subsequently issued an apology regarding the incident after facing significant public fallout.
